title: Gravity is the curvature response to conserved transport stress

statements.text: Curvature responds to the stress of the temporal medium through $G_{\mu\nu} = k_t T^t_{\mu\nu}$, consistent with stress conservation by the Bianchi identity, and the weak-field limit returns Newtonian gravity sourced by temporal density.

sources.quote: In this precise sense, gravity is the curvature response of the manifold to conserved transport stress.
Equation (25) shows that Chronoflux density sources the weak field gravitational potential.
